strategy.summary: Reproduce the SuppFuncAtom._value_impl accuracy defect: its hardcoded SCS solve at eps=1e-6 gives an absolute error of 1.5707e-06 on test_vector2norm, which exceeds the asserted 1e-06 bound. On the buggy commit a4b9e106004c the test should fail; on the fix fb341062e (switch to CLARABEL) it should pass. Plan around SCS 3.3.1 as the observed solver version, with SCS 3.2.9 as an unverified alternate.

pip_packages: diffcp (optional; install if available, otherwise tests may be skipped)
pinned_because: SCS 3.3.1: the observed failure (error 1.5706827991568417e-06) was recorded under SCS 3.3.1 per issue#3514 and the PR body, and the README/pyproject floor (scs>=3.2.4.post1) is documented but does not by itself pin the observed behaviour.
NumPy 2.4.6 and SciPy 1.17.1: validated versions stated in PR#3513; documented floors are numpy>=2.0.0 and scipy>=1.13.0, so these are validated rather than required.

SCS 3.2.9: listed as a tested version in PR#3513 with no documented constraint; not chosen as primary because the failure was observed under 3.3.1, but it is the fallback if 3.3.1 cannot be installed.
diffcp: no documented constraint; installed only if available because the PR says its tests are skipped when absent.

strategy.reproducing_test: cvxpy/tests/test_suppfunc.py::test_vector2norm (the support-function test asserting abs(actual - 1.6260907190) <= 1e-6). The supplied PR diff edits other tests (test_KKT, test_conic_solvers, test_domain, test_dqcp, test_problem, test_semidefinite_vars) that switch solvers to CLARABEL; these are not the numerical transition and should not be relied on as the reproducer.
strategy.success_criterion: On buggy commit a4b9e106004c, pytest cvxpy/tests/test_suppfunc.py -k vector2norm fails: the SCS-based .value gives abs error 1.5706827991568417e-06, which is not <= 1e-06, so an AssertionError is raised. On fixed commit fb341062e, the same command passes because SuppFuncAtom._value_impl uses CLARABEL and the error is well below 1e-6.
strategy.numerical_probe: Compare the .value of the vector2norm support function against the analytic 1.6260907190 under SCS 3.3.1 (buggy, expected about 1.57e-06 error) and CLARABEL (fixed, expected far below 1e-6).

input_output_examples.input: Support function .value in test_suppfunc.py::test_vector2norm, evaluated through SuppFuncAtom._value_impl with SCS eps=1e-6 (buggy) versus CLARABEL (fixed)

risks: The failure is tied to SCS 3.3.1 behaviour at eps=1e-6. Under other SCS versions (including 3.2.9) the error may be below 1e-6 and the test may not fail, so the transition may not occur.
The transition depends on the exact SCS linear solver. Default SCS 3.3+ uses qdldl (direct); the indirect cpu_indirect path may give a different error, so the default is assumed.

Platform-specific: the evidence does not state an architecture, compiler, or threading setting, so none is assumed. The defect is not expected to need a sanitiser, but if the SCS wheel differs by platform the 1.57e-06 magnitude may not reproduce exactly.
If diffcp is absent, support-function tests may be skipped, which would produce no transition at all; check for skip markers in the test run output.

The supplied reproducing diff mixes in SCS linear_solver option tests (test_scs_linear_solver_options, test_scs_explicit_linear_solver) that depend on mocking scs.__version__ and are unrelated to the numerical error; they may fail on the buggy tree for reasons unrelated to this bug.
Clarabel is documented as >=0.5.0 with no pinned value; the fixed-side result relies on the installed Clarabel version, which the evidence does not state.
The numeric values (1.5706827991568417e-06, 1.6260907190, 1.6260907142) come from the issue and PR text and were not independently verified here.

oracle.reference_source: analytic support function value 1.6260907190 for test_vector2norm (from issue#3514 / PR#3513 evidence)
oracle.why: The test asserts a fixed absolute bound; the buggy SCS eps=1e-6 solve exceeds it, and the CLARABEL-based fix is expected to satisfy it.

strategy.fails_on_buggy: The assertion sees abs error 1.5706827991568417e-06 from the SCS eps=1e-6 solve in SuppFuncAtom._value_impl. That is larger than the asserted 1e-06, so the assertion fails.
strategy.passes_on_fixed: With SuppFuncAtom._value_impl switched to CLARABEL (fb341062e), the error is expected to be well below 1e-06 (the lifted primal error of about 4.8e-09 and standalone dual error of about 1.5e-13 suggest the exact value is reachable), so the assertion holds.
